title: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter Movie Reveals Trailer, February 5 2027 Premiere
content:
The last part of the trilogy, Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club Final Chapter movie released a trailer on Friday. The movie is set to release on February 5, 2027 in Japan.

The first part of the trilogy premiered in Japan on September 6, 2024, while the second part was released on November 7, 2025. The voice cast consists of:

• Hinaki Yano as Yu Takasaki

• Aguri Onishi as Ayumu Uehara

• Akari Kito as Kanata Konoe

• Chiemi Tanaka as Rina Tennoji

• Kaori Maeda as Shizuku Osaka

• Maria Sashide as Emma Verde

• Mayu Sagara as Kasumi Nakasu

• Miyu Kubota as Karin Asaka

• Natsumi Murakami as Ai Miyashita

• Coco Hayashi as Setsuna Yuki

• Moeka Koizumi as Shioriko Mifune

• Akina Homoto as Lanzhu Zhong

• Shu Uchida as Mia Taylor

Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club is a spin-off project of Love Live! idol franchise. The first season began broadcasting in October 2020 while the second aired in April 2022. An OVA premiered in June 2023. Studio Sunrise was in charge of all the production of the Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club anime.

Crunchyroll is streaming the first and second seasons of Love Live Nijigasaki School Idol Club anime and describes it as: Nijigasaki High School is known for their diverse subjects and the freedom they give to students. Second-year student Yu Takasaki has been turned on to the charms of school idols, so she knocks on the door of the School Idol Club with her friend, Ayumu Uehara. Sometimes friends, sometimes rivals, the members of this club each contribute their own thoughts and motivations to the group.
author: Anime Corner

title: Record of Lodoss War: The Crown of the Covenant Novel Series Resumes
content:
Kadokawa published the first novel volume in Japan in September 2019 with illustrations by Hidari . The novel was the first new novel for the Record of Lodoss War franchise in 12 years.

Atsushi Suzumi launched a manga adaptation of the new novel in October 2019. Udon Entertainment released the three-volume manga in English. The company describes the story:

A new era of adventure has begun in the fabled world of RECORD OF LODOSS WAR ! Thanks to “The Crown of the Covenant”, the accursed isle of Lodoss has seen peace for 100 years. However, the ambitious ruler of the kingdom of Flaim now threatens to return Lodoss to a state of war. Heroes appear once more, as the young prince Lyle of Marmo seeks the help of the legendary high elf, Deedlit. Will a new “Knight of Lodoss” arise to save all the kingdoms?

Record of Lodoss War : Queen of Death , the first webtoon from Studio White, launched globally in August 2025. The webtoon is an official spin-off set before the original story, following the fall of the Kingdom of Kastuul on the island of Lodoss. The series originally launched in South Korea in May 2025. Southern Camel is credited with the adaptation, with Blanton providing the artwork. Studio White is a joint production studio established by Kadokawa , LINE Digital Frontier , and REDICE STUDIO .

Record of Lodoss War began as a series of magazine articles that recounted the pencil-and-paper role-playing game sessions of players who called themselves Group SNE . Those fantasy adventures evolved into a series of novels by Mizuno.

Mizuno's Record of Lodoss War stories inspired the 1990 Record of Lodoss War video anime series and the 1998 Record of Lodoss War: Chronicles of the Heroic Knight television anime sequel.
author: ANN

title: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War Reveals The Last Trailer Ahead of Final 2 New Episodes
content:
BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War has released a new ‘the last’ trailer ahead of the anime’s final two episodes, set to conclude Tite Kubo’s final manga arc. The anime returned with the fourth and final cour, subtitled The Calamity , on July 25, before delaying the final two episodes to improve quality . It is set to run for 10 episodes.

The first half of the new PV looks back at the events of Thousand-Year Blood War and the path leading Ichigo Kurosaki and Yhwach toward their final confrontation. Episode 49 will air on October 19, followed by the series finale, Episode 50, on October 26. A special marathon screening and talk event will also be held on October 25 at United Cinemas Aqua City Odaiba in Japan, one day before the finale airs. Scheduled guests include Masakazu Morita, the voice of Ichigo Kurosaki, Noriaki Sugiyama, the voice of Uryu Ishida, original creator Tite Kubo, director Hikaru Murata and animation producer Sadahiko Tominaga. You can watch the new trailer below.

Created by Tite Kubo, BLEACH was serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2001 to 2016 and concluded with 74 volumes. The manga has exceeded 130 million copies in circulation worldwide, making it one of the best-selling manga series of all time.

The original anime adaptation aired from 2004 to 2012 and received four theatrical films. The franchise returned in 2022 with BLEACH: Thousand-Year Blood War , adapting the manga’s final arc. Its final part (Part 4) is set to release in July. Tite Kubo has confirmed it will include even more original material than the previous parts , expanding the manga’s final battles.

On a related note, BLEACH: Mirrors High revealed its protagonists in a new trailer, with the game featuring original character designs by Tite Kubo.

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora Anime Film Reveals 2nd Promo Video
content:
The official YouTube channel for the BanG Dream! franchise began streaming a second promotional video on Friday for the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film project. The video previews Ave Mujica's song "A Song of Romance."

The film opened in Japan on Friday.

The BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! /Ave Mujica sequel television anime series will premiere in January 2027. The series will air on NTV and 29 affiliated channels in Japan. A promo video for the new series is screening after showings of the BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora anime film.

BanG Dream! It's MyGo!!!!! premiered in Japan on Tokyo MX and streaming service ABEMA with three episodes in June 2023. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired.

The anime has two compilation films . Haru no Hidamari, Mayoi Neko (A Sunny Spot in Spring, A Stray Cat), the first film, opened in September 2024. The second film, titled Utau, Bokura ni Nareru Uta (Sing, the Song That Can Define Us), opened in November 2024.

Bushiroad launched the BanG Dream! multimedia project in January 2015. The main BanG Dream! television anime's first 13-episode season premiered in January 2017. The BanG Dream! 3rd Season television anime debuted in January 2020.

The franchise also includes the BanG Dream! FILM LIVE and BanG Dream! FILM LIVE 2nd Stage films, the two-part BanG Dream! Episode of Roselia films, as well as several web anime spinoff series.

title: Golden Kamuy's Live-Action Adaptation Continues With 'Karafuto Pursuit Arc' Series in January
content:
WOWOW announced on Friday it will stream a new live-action series based on Satoru Noda 's Golden Kamuy manga starting on January 24 at 10:00 p.m. The series is titled Golden Kamuy : Karafuto Tsuiseki-hen (Golden Kamuy: Karafuto Pursuit Arc).

Kenji Katagiri is returning to direct the new series alongside new director Masaaki Yoshimura . Tetsuo Kamata (live-action BLUE LOCK film) is the new scriptwriter. Yutaka Yamada and Yoshiaki Dewa are returning to compose the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe are again serving as the Ainu language and cultural advisers. CREDEUS is again producing the series.

The first live-action Golden Kamuy film opened in Japan in January 2024 and topped the Japanese box office in its first weekend. The film sold 356,000 tickets for 533,848,690 yen (about US$3.44 million in current conversion) in its first three days. Netflix began streaming the first film in May 2024.

Shigeaki Kubo directed the first film at production company CREDEUS . Tsutomu Kuroiwa wrote the script. Yutaka Yamada composed the music. Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe were credited as Ainu culture advisers.

Kenji Katagiri , Ken Ochiai , and Yōsuke Satō joined the film's director Kubo on directing the follow-up Golden Kamuy -The Hunt of Prisoners in Hokkaido- live-action series . Similarly, Yoshiaki Dewa joined the film's composer Yamada for the series. Japanese rock group ACIDMAN performed the theme song "Kagayakerumono" (Those Who Shine). The live-action series debuted in October 2024, and Netflix added the series in February 2025.

Kento Yamazaki reprises his role as Saichi Sugimoto and Anna Yamada as Asirpa. Yū Inaba , Sōkō Wada , and Tetta Sugimoto joined the film's cast as Tokishige Usami, Toshiyuki Kadokura, and Anji Toni, respectively.

Kenji Katagiri directed the film at CREDEUS based on a script by returning writer Tsutomu Kuroiwa . Yutaka Yamada was also back to compose the music, and Hiroshi Nakagawa and Debo Akibe served as Ainu culture and language supervisors.

Rock band 10-FEET performed the theme song "Kowarete Kieru made" (Until It Breaks and Disappears).

Noda launched the manga in Shueisha 's Young Jump magazine in 2014, and ended it in April 2022. The manga has inspired four anime seasons. The show's final arc premiered on January 5, and will continue this winter with the climactic "Runaway Train" arc.

title: Wound & Bandage TV Anime Reveals Main Cast, January 9 Debut in Teaser Video
content:
The official website for television anime of Umihoshi Nanai 's Wound & Bandage ( Kizuguchi to Hōtai ) manga revealed a teaser promotional video on Friday. The website also revealed the anime's main cast and January 9 debut.

The anime stars Hisako Kanemoto as Riyo Washizu, and Chikahiro Kobayashi as Gō Kiritani.

Miyuki Ishida ( I.Cinnamoroll , director, One Punch Man season 2 and 3 episode director) is directing the anime at J.C. Staff . Susumu Yamakawa ( The Way of the Househusband three seasons, Murai in Love ) is writing the scripts, and Natsuki Ōyama ( Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive? ) is designing the characters.

The romantic comedy centers on Riyo Washizu, the daughter of the leader of the yakuza organization that occupies the Kanto region of Japan. Gō Kiritani, a young subordinate in the organization, becomes Riyo's caretaker. He expects her to be just a docile child, but he soon learns that Riyo has a certain fetish — she loves seeing strong people when they are weak.

The manga debuted on Kodansha 's Comic Days app in August 2024. Kodansha shipped the fifth volume on July 16.

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Reveals 2 More Cast Members
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Friday two more cast members for Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . Both characters will appear in the show's 15th episode on October 18.

Hirofumi Nojima as Umezō, an inhabitant of the magical country Felix Star.

Shōgo Yano as Tachibana, an actor playing the headmaster's son in the drama Lilly and Rin are shooting.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime's second part debuted on October 4.

The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 13th episode posted on October 10, and now has subtitles in 26 languages. As of writing, the anime's full episodes are not available in Southeast Asia.

Previously announced new cast members for the second part include Miyari Nemoto as Asahi Araki, Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, and Yūko Natsuyoshi as Shiromofu.

K-pop girl group ILLIT performs the new opening theme song "Swingin' Magic." The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's story centers on sisters Fū and Rui, who used to be close, but have been a bit distant from each other recently. One day, Fū encounters a mysterious spaceship and gains magical powers. At that same time, Rui also gains magical powers, and both transform into the adults they dream to be. The sisters' powers come with two conditions: their magic powers can only be used in one year, and no one must know about it. Unaware of each other's secrets, Fū and Rui become active as idols.
author: ANN

title: 'Kizuguchi to Houtai' Reveals Main Cast, Teaser Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nanai Umihoshi 's Kizuguchi to Houtai ( Wound and Bandage ) manga revealed the main cast, a theme visual (pictured), and teaser promotional video on Friday. The anime series will premiere on January 9, 2027 at 11:00 p.m. on AT-X, followed by ABC TV and TV Asahi on the ANiMAZiNG programming block.

Voice actors Hisako Kanemoto ( Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun ) and Chikahiro Kobayashi ( Beastars ) are starring as Riyo Washizu and Gou Kiritani, respectively.

Miyuki Ishida ( Danjo no Yuujou wa Seiritsu suru? (Iya, Shinai!!) assistant director) is helming the anime at J.C.Staff , with Susumu Yamakawa ( Gokushufudou series composition) penning the script. Natsuki Ooyama ( 2.5-jigen no Ririsa animation director) is designing the characters.

Umihoshi originally began the romantic comedy manga as a one-shot in Getsumaga Kichi magazine in February 2024. The manga began serializing in Comic Days magazine the following August. Kodansha published the fifth volume on July 16.

title: Magical DoReMi, Star Detective Precure! Anime Get Crossover Episode on October 25
content:
The official website for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise , revealed on Friday that the anime will have a crossover episode with the Ojamajo Doremi ( Magical DoReMi ) anime with its 39th episode on October 25. The site unveiled a collaboration visual, as well as character visuals for the Star Detectives in Ojamajo Doremi -themed witch apprentice costumes.

The story of Star Detective Precure! is set in 1999, the year of the original Ojamajo Doremi anime's premiere. The crossover episode will be a Halloween-themed episode that has the Star Detectives donning the witch apprentice costumes.

The first Ojamajo Doremi anime series originally premiered in Japan in 1999, and 4Kids began broadcasting a heavily edited version of the series in the United States in 2005 under the title Magical DoReMi . Looking for Magical DoReMi ( Majo Minarai o Sagashite ), the anime film commemorating the 20th anniversary of Ojamajo Doremi , opened in 2020 after a delay. It won the Best Animation Film award at the 75th Mainichi Film Awards in 2021.

Star Detective Precure! debuted on February 1 on ABC TV, TV Asahi , and their affiliate channels at 8:30 a.m. JST. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime in North America, Central America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Europe, Africa, the Middle East and CIS.

The anime centers on Anna Akechi, a second year middle school student who lives in Makoto Mirai Town. She travels back in time from 2027 to 1999 when her "companion fairy" named Pochitan appears on her birthday. In 1999 Makoto Mirai Town, Anna meets Mikuru Kobayashi, another second year middle school student who dreams of becoming a great detective. The two girls witness the troubles caused by the Phantom Thieves who steal people's precious belongings, and they transform into great Precure detectives and use their deductive reasoning skills to protect the people's smiles.
